workspace.author: Alison
workspace.text:
Hi Brad, I've read Priya Raman and Marcus Hale's calendars. Here are the time slots where BOTH are free for a 30-minute meeting:

- Monday: 9:00-9:30 or 9:30-10:00
- Friday: 11:00-11:30 or 11:30-12:00

Could you check Elena Soto and David Okafor's calendars and let me know which of these slots they're available for? Or if you find other overlapping times, please share.

workspace.author: Brad
workspace.text:
Hi Alison, I've checked Elena Soto and David Okafor's calendars. Unfortunately, none of the slots you provided work for them:

- Monday 9:00-9:30: Elena is busy (Contract review) and David is busy (Quarterly planning)
- Monday 9:30-10:00: Elena is busy (Recruiting call) and David is busy (Recruiting call)
- Friday 11:00-11:30: Elena is busy (Client dinner prep) and David is busy (Training session)
- Friday 11:30-12:00: Elena is busy (1:1 with associate) and David is busy (Litigation strategy)

Since these are the only times Priya and Marcus are both free, and Elena and David are unavailable during all of those slots, there is no time next week when all four partners can meet. I recommend we report this as infeasible.

workspace.author: Alison
workspace.text:
Wait, I need to double-check my analysis. I may have missed some slots where Priya and Marcus are both free. Here's the complete list:

- Monday: 9:00-10:00
- Tuesday: 13:00-14:00, 16:30-17:00
- Wednesday: 15:00-16:00
- Thursday: 10:00-10:30, 14:30-15:00
- Friday: 11:00-12:00

Could you check Elena and David's availability for ALL these slots, not just the ones I initially listed? There may be a time that works for everyone.

workspace.author: Brad
workspace.text:
I've checked all the slots against Elena and David's calendars. Here's the analysis:

- Monday 9:00-10:00: Both Elena and David are busy the entire time.
- Tuesday 13:00-14:00: Both Elena and David are busy the entire time.
- Tuesday 16:30-17:00: Both Elena and David are busy.
- Wednesday 15:00-16:00: David is busy the entire time (Partner lunch 15:00-15:30, Busy 15:30-16:00).
- Thursday 10:00-10:30: Elena is busy (Hiring panel).
- Thursday 14:30-15:00: BOTH Elena and David are FREE! This works.
- Friday 11:00-12:00: Both Elena and David are busy the entire time.

The only slot that works for all four partners is Thursday, November 19, 14:30-15:00. Please create the booking for this time, and I'll send the confirmation email once you confirm it's booked.

workspace.author: Alison
workspace.text: Booking created successfully for Thursday 14:30-15:00. Please send the confirmation email to the partners.
